description: U.S. Street Network Analytic Measures is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Geoff Boeing (Northeastern University). Metric and topological measures of the street networks of every US city/town, urbanized area, county, census tract, and Zillow-defined neighborhood. These variables are calculated from OpenStreetMap data using the a href="https://github.com/gboeing/osmnx" OSMnx /a software. Full methodological details in the related publications. See citation info. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2017. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 253118. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
